span.p:
ENG1013 traceability map
subsystem requirement to portfolio evidence

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S1 Approach height detection
Purpose: detect over-height vehicles before the exit
Code: integrated_subsystems_1_2.py and Integrated_Sub1+Sub4_Code/
Evidence: subsystem flowchart, wiring guide, prototype photos

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S2 Tunnel Ave control
Purpose: manage traffic lights and pedestrian crossing behaviour
Code: integrated_subsystems_1_2.py, integrated_subsystems_2_3.py, Integrated_SUB2+SUB3.py
Evidence: wiring guides, circuit PNG sheets, photos, demos

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S3 Over-height exit
Purpose: route unsafe vehicles away from the tunnel
Code: subsystem3_overheight_exit.py, integrated_subsystems_2_3.py, Integrated_SUB2+SUB3.py
Evidence: Subsystem 3 wiring guide, circuit PNG sheets, videos

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S4 Tunnel entrance detection
Purpose: final tunnel-height check and closure behaviour
Code: Integrated_Sub1+Sub4_Code/
Evidence: subsystem flowchart and integration source folder

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S5 Failure alert
Purpose: hardware-only alert and override during detection power loss
Circuit evidence: exported circuit PNG sheets and redacted circuit PDF
Portfolio note: keep hardware-only behaviour traceable to photos/videos where available
